授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
In this lecture, fundamental knowledge of elasticity is studied in order to understand the stress condition of a solid body. Especially, the followings are studied.
1)The definition of stress and strain and their relation (constitutive law)
2) Equilibrium equation of stress
3) Displacement and strain relations
4) Principal stress
5) Plane problem (comparing with 3-D problem)
6) Yield condition
